title: Might deserve only 2 stars
text: Might deserve only 2 stars. I almost gave this two stars, but went with 3. The bottle does look nice, and has a decent heft to it, but there's a bit of leakage at the top around the nozzle. However, I'm not using this as intended, so it may be my own fault to some degree. I bought some toilet drops, and decided I needed something nicer to put it in since it's basically on display in the bathroom. I doubt this stuff has the same consistency as bitters (basically a concoction of dyes and essential oils), so I may have caused the problem myself. I do have to say that, though it leaks a little, it isn't leaking enough that I've stopped using it. I just wipe the top ever few uses.

product_metadata.title: SuproBarware Bitter Bottle – Glass Bitter Bottle with Dash Top, 1.7oz/50ml, Great for Bartender, Home Bar – KJP01-C (Copper)
features: The 1.7oz/50ml Bitters Bottle is the perfect piece of barware to a beautifully showcase and dispense your bitters flavors - evenly and in style.
Add a fashion look and feel to your home bar tools set up - or improve your bar top display at a commercial bar.
Metal dash top dispense bitters smoothly and accurately. Wide and weighty bottom gives way to the long narrow neck to help to evenly dispense the correct sized dashes of bitters into your cocktails.
Hand wash only. If changing bitters, rinse thoroughly with soap and water and let dry upside down.
Dasher top can be disassembled by unscrewing and removing cork for further cleaning if desired.
